---
title: "The Ops Zoo"
subtitle: "Operational Thresholds and Training-Run Profiles"
---

The Ops Zoo provides **operational anchors** for fleet operations: PSI drift thresholds,
KS-test coefficients, memory bit-error rates, and reusable training-run goodput-loss
profiles used in MLOps, robust-AI, and distributed-training chapters.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import mlsysim
from mlsysim.core.provenance import scalar_value

sections = [
    ("Monitoring & Drift Thresholds", "Monitoring"),
    ("Training Run Overheads", "TrainingRunOverheads"),
    ("Runtime Dispatch Overheads", "RuntimeOverheads"),
    ("Memory Protection & ECC", "MemoryProtection"),
    ("Preemption & Recovery", "Preemption"),
]

for title, key in sections:
    reg = getattr(mlsysim.Ops, key, None)
    if reg is None:
        continue
    print(f"## {title} (`Ops.{key}`)\n")
    print("| Entry | Value | Description |")
    print("|:---|:---:|:---|")
    for item in reg.list():
        name = getattr(item, "name", type(item).__name__)
        desc = getattr(item, "description", "") or "---"
        raw = getattr(item, "value", item)
        if hasattr(raw, "magnitude"):
            val = f"{raw:~P}"
        elif isinstance(raw, float):
            val = f"{raw:g}"
        else:
            try:
                val = f"{scalar_value(item):g}"
            except TypeError:
                val = raw
        print(f"| **{name}** | {val} | {desc} |")
    print()
```

## Python Access

```python
import mlsysim

psi_warn = mlsysim.Ops.Monitoring.PsiWarnThreshold
psi_critical = mlsysim.Ops.Monitoring.PsiCriticalThreshold
checkpoint_overhead = mlsysim.Ops.TrainingRunOverheads.Checkpoint
```

These are assumption tables for teaching and appendix lineage, not live alerting defaults
for production systems.
